Description
Part of Yamanashi Gakuin University, the International College of Liberal Arts (iCLA) is a liberal arts college located in Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. Following an American-style curriculum, the college offers a four-year degree program, featuring a large range of courses, leading to a Bachelor of International Liberal Arts degree.
